verdict.rationale: Datalab's docs describe document processing as jobs that complete asynchronously. Webhooks send real-time notifications when those jobs complete, which the docs say removes the need for continuous polling, and a per-request webhook_url override is supported. Together this covers the core non-blocking pipeline story, but the status-polling side is only implied, not shown. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented job-submission/request_id flow, a documented status-polling endpoint, and independent or hands-on corroboration of async behavior on long parses.
